description: Ministry of Heath, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Notify the Amendment to the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to an amendment of the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute, specifically modifying service conditions and qualifications for nursing officers. This falls under public sector service administration, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government personnel/structure matter (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories.
